notes.summary: A time series is data recorded over time (years, quarters, months). We split it into trend, seasonal, cyclical and irregular parts. JSO asks on identifying components, moving averages, least-squares trend and seasonal indices.

concepts.title: Components
concepts.body:
• Secular trend (T): long-term upward or downward movement (population growth).
  • Seasonal (S): regular pattern within a year (more umbrellas sold in monsoon).
  • Cyclical (C): business-cycle waves lasting more than a year (boom, recession, depression, recovery).
  • Irregular (I): random, unpredictable (floods, strikes, pandemics).
  • Models: multiplicative Y = T × S × C × I; additive Y = T + S + C + I.

concepts.title: Measuring trend
concepts.body:
• Moving averages: average of consecutive k values, placed at the middle. Even k needs centring.
  • Least squares: fit y = a + bx. With x coded so Σx = 0: a = Σy/n, b = Σxy/Σx².
  • Semi-averages and freehand methods are simpler but less exact.

concepts.title: Seasonal indices
concepts.body: Methods: simple averages, ratio-to-trend, ratio-to-moving-average, link relatives. Quarterly indices add up to 400; monthly indices add up to 1200 (average 100).

varieties.name: Identify the component
varieties.how: Within a year and repeating → seasonal; multi-year waves → cyclical; long-term → trend; sudden → irregular.

example.q: Sales fall sharply after an earthquake. Which component?

varieties.name: Moving averages and seasonal indices
varieties.how: Average each consecutive block; seasonal indices must total 400 (quarters) or 1200 (months).

varieties.name: Least-squares trend
varieties.how: Code years so Σx = 0, compute a and b, then substitute x for the target year.

example.q: Trend y = 120 + 5x, origin 2022, x in years. Estimate for 2026.

tips: For an odd number of years, take the middle year as origin (x = 0).
Moving averages smooth out cycles whose length equals the period of the average.
A trend line cannot predict irregular events.
traps: Seasonal means within one year, not "every few years" (that is cyclical).
A 4-year moving average needs centring to line up with actual years.
Check the unit of x (half-years, years) before substituting.

questions.q: More woollen clothes are sold every winter. This variation is:
questions.solution: The pattern repeats every year within the year, so it is seasonal variation.

questions.q: Fluctuations caused by business cycles (boom, recession, depression, recovery) are called:
questions.solution: Business-cycle waves last more than a year and are called cyclical variations.

questions.q: Sales for 5 years are 10, 14, 18, 16, 20. The 3-year moving average centred on the 3rd year is:
A trend equation is y = 50 + 4x with origin 2020 and x in years. The trend value for 2025 is:
Values for 2019–2023 are 10, 12, 15, 17, 21. Fitting a straight-line trend by least squares (origin 2021), the estimate for 2025 is:
Seasonal indices for Q1, Q2 and Q3 are 90, 110 and 120. The index for Q4 is:
questions.solution:
Quarterly seasonal indices add up to 400.
Q4 = 400 − (90 + 110 + 120) = 400 − 320 = 80.
